resources.string: Dynamic Telegram download scheduling hook for obfuscated builds. Original author: AraafRoyall.

Choose a download scheduling profile, then save and force-stop Telegram before reopening it.
Warning: force-stopping interrupts active downloads, calls, and other Telegram operations. Root permission is required the first time.

Balanced and High requests both use 1 MiB chunks. Obfuscated class names are discovered dynamically. Only client-side scheduling for ordinary large files is adjusted; server limits are not changed and a speed increase is not guaranteed. Connection and request counts are upper bounds, not a promise of active concurrency.
Shared preferences are unavailable. Enable this module in a compatible LSPosed setup, wait for the module cache to refresh, and reopen this screen. Telegram was not modified or stopped.
Saving settings and requesting Root permission. Watch for the authorization prompt...

Settings are read the next time Telegram starts. If Root permission is denied, the setting is still saved but Telegram must be force-stopped manually.

Log tag: TgSpeedHook
PROFILE: profile read by the hook
PARAMS_APPLIED: download parameters written and read back
BUDGET_APPLIED: budget lanes and request limit written and read back
UNSUPPORTED / POLICY_DISABLED: discovery failed or later changes were disabled

Original author: AraafRoyall
